unresolved_gaps: No primary filing was read directly; seller backlogs and OpenAI contract values come from secondary analyses, and the Oracle and Amazon OpenAI figures are partly press-reported.
Backlog is not the same as all future cloud revenue. Revenue not yet contracted would lower OpenAI's share, and the size of that effect is unknown.
OpenAI's Google Cloud commitment is undisclosed, so the numerator is understated.
